items.title: Gap Mangione interviewed by Monk Rowe, Rochester, New York, January 11, 2012
items.q: and of course Tom, another bass player from Buffalo who’s a knockout.

ctx.x: Yeah. There’s another fella, Frank Pullaro, who is a bass player up here, and of course Tom, another bass player from Buffalo who’s a knockout. Can’t remember his name right now. But anyway, large groups of Italian jazz players.
Well did you have, were your parents into Italian folk music, like mandolin type?
